bullets.text: A school van driver was arrested in Red Hills under the POCSO Act for sexually abusing a 5-year-old girl, while police inaction drew complaints.
Chennai experienced sudden heavy rain causing waterlogging, and the meteorological department forecasts heavy rain in eight districts tomorrow on Diwali.
Velachery witnessed heavy traffic congestion with vehicles lining up and motorists struggling to move.
A couple went to Besant Nagar at 2 AM to watch the sunrise and faced a shocking incident.
Southern Railway is awaiting RDSO clearance to rectify the platform-train gap at the newly constructed Adambakkam station.
The home department transferred four police officers, appointing Hari Kiran Prasad as Ramanathapuram SP and Eswaran as Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner.
BSNL announced the upcoming launch of 4G services under phase IX.2 in Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, and Chengalpattu districts.
Police arrested three Andhra men for a burglary near Pallipattu in Tiruvallur district after a year, recovering 86.5 sovereign gold.
Avadi and Tambaram city police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized ganja, narcotic tablets, and other contraband products.
Udhayanidhi Stalin stated that the DMK is fully prepared for an inquiry into the Periyar Arivulagam library book procurement controversy.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay ordered a Rs 2,000-crore allocation to implement the Vetri Laptop Scheme for college students.
Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by over 10,000 AMD GPUs.
The Periyar Arivulagam book procurement controversy escalated as the TVK government blamed the previous regime and formed a panel to inspect libraries.
Minister Rajmohan strongly condemned the opposition, alleging that the DMK committed the first AI corruption.
